bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/notices.sh" concise "concise is on. Fourteen commands, by destination: /concise:pr, :card, :commit, :comment, :release and :handoff write what leaves the conversation; :plan, :decide, :draw and :status shape what stays in it; :rewrite retrofits a finished text, :trim cuts the dead text out of code and screens, and :audit reports its violations for :rewrite to fix; :woman writes the reply to a heavy vent from someone close. This note shows once." "concise: self-update has been failing for over a week. Run %s to see the error."

bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/turn-reminder.sh" 'Style concise, this turn: the answer in the first sentence, carrying the result and not a bare yes; asked to describe something, reply with the one sentence that says what it is and stop, the rest left for when it is asked, and a second sentence only for bad news or a caveat that changes what the reader does; a question, an explanation or a status update gets five lines at most, fences not counted; a choice the reader makes keeps its options side by side in a table, and a report in the chat on finished work keeps one line per deliverable, past five lines if it must, every exact value kept, and a line in it naming three parts becomes three lines; always keep bad news, exact values and real uncertainty, each said once; a name the reader will never type or open - a constant, a helper, a table - reaches them as what it does; preamble, recap, narration, the plan for your next tool calls, a risk or pending step already stated, and the tour of what you delivered all go; in code, a comment says only what the code leaves unsaid.' .concise-no-turn-reminder 'card,tarefa,ticket,issue|A card stands alone: the title opens with the area, then what changes; current state and expected state; numbered steps to reproduce a bug; every exact value; the open question named; a done criterion; no headers inside the body, and nothing only a reader of this conversation would understand.' 'coment,comment,mensagem,message,revis,review|A comment is three lines or fewer in one paragraph: the claim first, the evidence that matters, the anchor path in full, and whether it blocks the merge; no greeting, praise, sign-off, header, or note after it.' 'pr ,pull request,descricao da pr,descricao da PR,merge request|A PR description runs in three sections under headers - what is solved, what was done, how to test - the problem first in the words of the reader, each deliverable said once, at most twenty-five lines of prose, every caveat kept, each command in its own fence with the output it prints, and no internal name the reviewer never types or opens - the exact path of every file the reviewer opens stays in.' 'draw,desenh,diagram,fluxo|A drawing is one fenced block tagged text, under fifteen lines, no line past 72 characters, one glyph set throughout, every arrow labelled, each cost or note hanging off the box it belongs to, what you did not measure named as unmeasured, and no legend.' 'create a card,cria o card,crie o card,criar o card,escreva o card,escrever o card,card for this,card dessa,card desse,card disso,abra um card,novo card|If this turn writes a card: it stands alone - the title opens with the area, then what changes; current state and expected state; numbered steps to reproduce a bug; every exact value; the open question named; a done criterion; no headers inside the body, and nothing only a reader of this conversation would understand.' 'coment,comment,revis,review|If this turn writes a review comment: three lines or fewer in one paragraph - the claim first, the evidence that matters, the anchor path in full, and whether it blocks the merge; no greeting, praise, sign-off, header, or note after it.' 'pr description,da pr ,da pr.,pull request,merge request|If this turn writes a PR description: three sections under headers - what is solved, what was done, how to test - the problem first in the words of the reader, each deliverable said once, at most twenty-five lines of prose, every caveat kept, each command in its own fence with the output it prints, no internal name the reviewer never types or opens, and the exact path of every file the reviewer opens.' 'commit|If this turn writes a commit message: the title says what changed in the shape the log of the repository uses, and a body of six lines at most that is usually unnecessary.' 'draw,desenh,diagram,fluxo|If this turn draws: one fenced block tagged text, under fifteen lines, no line past 72 characters, one glyph set throughout, every arrow labelled, each cost or note hanging off the box it belongs to, what you did not measure named as unmeasured, and no legend.'
